## Où j'en suis
Tradewell webhook certification work: PR #1468 (signed delivery + retries, SKIP LOCKED queue, dead-letter after 24h) was approved by Tomer and merged into main (commit 5d1c0aa), and the work moved to a new branch `jake/tradewell-webhook-cert` to fix the two failing cert tests from the first sandbox run (46/48). WH-17 is fixed (commit c41f9a2e: `failure_code`/`failure_message` in `payout.ts`, snapshot updated, tests green). WH-31 (signing at send time with a fresh timestamp) is written in `delivery.rs`, unit tests green, but not committed and the retry integration test in `tests/retry.rs` still needs rewriting. The sandbox cert re-run is blocked: the Tradewell sandbox API key expired on 2026-11-17, Ellen must reissue it. Deadline: passing cert run by Friday Nov 20 (QPAY-2310), for the Dec 7 go-live. (source: ses-tw-3, src-pr1468, src-jira-2310)

- [en-cours] WH-31: fresh-timestamp signing at send time, uncommitted; `tests/retry.rs` integration test still checks the old pre-computed header and needs rewriting — Jake said he'll finish and push it tomorrow morning (source: ses-tw-3)
- [prochaine-étape] Re-run the Tradewell sandbox certification (`./scripts/tradewell-cert.sh --env sandbox`) once the API key is reissued; a green run is needed before Friday (source: ses-tw-3)
- [essai-raté] cert script run blocked: 401 Unauthorized, sandbox partner API key expired 2026-11-17, nothing was tested (source: ses-tw-3)
- [essai-raté] retry scheduler with Postgres advisory locks sent 0.8% duplicate deliveries under k6 load; replaced with a queue table claimed via FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED (source: ses-tw-2)
- [question] Ellen claims agreement on mTLS and payout.updated for go-live, but that's not in the spec and Jake doesn't recall it; on hold until Jake checks with Sofia — build nothing for it (source: ses-tw-3, src-slack-tradewell)
- [décision] Don't pile cert fixes onto #1468; work on a new branch `jake/tradewell-webhook-cert` (source: ses-tw-3)
- [décision] Sign each attempt at send time rather than asking Tradewell to raise the 300s tolerance — 300s is their standard for all partners (source: ses-tw-3)
- [décision] Retry cap at 24h then dead-letter queue visible in the dashboard; spec requires 12h minimum, 24h gives margin (source: ses-tw-2)
- [décision] Follow the Tradewell spec exactly: HMAC-SHA256 with shared secret, not Ed25519 (source: ses-tw-1)
